summary: Added two source-derived bounds without claiming any execution: (1) a completeness sweep of all 24 MessageTypes against isLocalMsg and their producer sites shows MsgForgetLeader is the only locally-produced type missing from the filter, so the finding is a single classification omission rather than a systemic pattern; (2) the incumbent leader runs the same CheckQuorum rule on itself — tickHeartbeat dispatches MsgCheckQuorum every election timeout, stepLeader steps down when ProgressTracker.QuorumActive is false and clears the peers' RecentActive flags each check — so in a CheckQuorum deployment any coexistence of two leaders is bounded by an election timeout of the incumbent's own clock rather than by the new leader's message delay. Three new verified source ranges were recorded for the second statement (raft.go tickHeartbeat, raft.go stepLeader MsgCheckQuorum, tracker/tracker.go QuorumActive). Validation passed with no execution requested; the bound is explicitly flagged as unmeasured in any receipt of this run.
